answer: Proposal: pay only verified novelty. Consensus scores each answer with a deterministic embedding model against the pool and pays only its novel kernel — content beyond threshold τ from every earlier answer this epoch; matched content is hollow filler worth zero. A nebula of cloned accounts collapses: k near-copies of one work split one share; k shares require k genuinely distinct works at real production cost, so identity count buys nothing. Assumption: auditors can rerun the check, so tampering is visible; paraphrase past τ remains the seam. A burned per-answer fee caps review spam.
